user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Tuneshine.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tuneshine. Check the address and that it's on the same network.

abort.already_configured: This Tuneshine is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tuneshine.

init.title: Idle screen
init.description: Choose what the Tuneshine shows while nothing is playing. Pages rotate in the order selected; artwork takes over as soon as music plays.

data.clock_show_date: Show day and date under the clock
data.active_entity: Only while this entity is on

data_description.camera_entities: A random camera from this list is shown each time the camera page comes round.
data_description.camera_interval: Minutes between camera snapshots. In between, the camera page is skipped. Battery cameras can wake up for every snapshot, so keep this high for them. 0 shows a fresh snapshot every time round.
data_description.templates: Each template is its own page with its own colour scheme. Use | or a new line to split lines; a short first line becomes a coloured heading tag. See the README for examples.
data_description.active_from: Leave both times empty to run all day. Windows can cross midnight, e.g. 07:00 to 23:00 or 22:00 to 06:00.
data_description.active_to: Outside these hours the Tuneshine shows its own idle image.
data_description.active_entity: Optional. The pages only show while this is on or home, e.g. a schedule helper, an input boolean, a person or a presence sensor.

error.weather_required: Choose a weather entity for the weather page.
error.camera_required: Choose at least one camera for the camera page.
error.template_required: Add at least one template for the template page.
error.schedule_incomplete: Set both times, or leave both empty.

show_text.name: Show text
show_text.description: Show a message on the Tuneshine for a while, over artwork too.

message.name: Message
message.description: Use | or a new line to split lines. Templates are supported.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show it for.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Colour scheme for the message. Defaults to red.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Show a camera snapshot or an image from a URL for a while, over artwork too.

url.name: URL
url.description: Image to download instead of a camera.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show it for.

show_page.name: Show page
show_page.description: Jump the idle rotation to a page.

page.name: Page
page.description: clock, weather, camera, template or template_2 and so on.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: End a message or image shown by Show text or Show image.
